title: Downfall
status_note: All entries are original PLANNED production asset specifications, not delivered 3D models. The map generator and native actors use clearly identified primitive PLACEHOLDER geometry.
coordinate_system: Unreal: centimeters at import, X forward, Y right, Z up. dimensions_m = X extent, Y extent, Z extent.
texture_policy: 8K is a source ceiling reserved for the hero operative and service vehicle. Split body/cabin/material sets according to entry UV notes; use streamed mips. Source resolutions are not promises of resident 8K.
quality_gates: LOD transition and groom fallback review
Dedicated server contains no render-dependent gameplay
Streaming memory and frame-time budget review
Licensed sources and performer consent review
